active_raw_datasets.source_type: Jenkins Core JVM Startup Runtime Crash
active_raw_datasets.description: Complete public GitHub Gist log of Jenkins core startup crash, detailing Jetty server initialization, Winstone servlet engine, and deep Stapler/Jelly Java exception stack traces.

data_integrity_rules.rule_1: Never label synthetic or augmented data as authentic Jenkins data.
data_integrity_rules.rule_2: Held-out test set must be strictly isolated before any training or augmentation.
data_integrity_rules.rule_3: No synthetic perturbations may share seed IDs across train/val/test boundaries.
